answer: Deposits are visible in harbor, and timber reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 25% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 160 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tide account. Each duplicate costs another 113 dollars in locked collateral and another 4 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
